evidence: The new fold-into-ambient-batch branch in `yorkie-note-store.ts` setLocalSelection (`if (this.activeRoot && this.activePresence) publish(...)`) is not exercised by any supplied test: yorkie-note-store.test.ts never calls setLocalSelection, and in notes-undo-integration.test.ts the remote-selection plugin's setLocalSelection call happens in its own plugin update(), after noteSync's update() has already opened and closed store.batch(), so activeRoot/activePresence are null (and jsdom's unfocused view takes the `head === null` early return). The notes-package tests that do call setLocalSelection use stub/MemNoteStore implementations, which cannot cover the Yorkie path. Impact is limited because nothing inside batch() currently publishes selection, so the branch is defensive/near-unreachable rather than a live defect — hence minor.
